settings.pageSubtitle: Manage archive configuration, access rules, security credentials, and full backups.

general.sectionDesc: Configure the family archive title, default interface language, and living person privacy rules.
general.lockedDesc: Instance settings are locked by the server environment (SETTINGS_LOCKED_FROM_ENV=true) and cannot be modified from the web interface.
general.treeTitleHint: Displayed in the top navigation bar, browser title, and printed family tree posters.
general.defaultLocaleHint: Initial language used for visitors before they select a personal preference.
general.privacySectionDesc: Control whether unauthenticated visitors can view the archive with automatic privacy redaction.
general.enablePublicLabel: Enable Public Site for Anonymous Visitors
general.enablePublicDesc: When enabled, living persons' vital dates and photos will be strictly masked. When disabled (default), anonymous visitors see only the Sign-In page.
general.livingThresholdHint: Individuals without a recorded death event born within this number of years are automatically treated as living.
general.savedDesc: Updated configuration is now active across the archive.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Read-only operational diagnostics and storage capacity

backups.title: Backups & Snapshots
backups.subtitle: Create full on-demand archives containing the database, original media files, and verification manifest.
backups.includeGedcomLabel: Include GEDZIP portability archive inside backup
backups.includeGedcomDesc: Writes a standard GEDCOM 7.0 bundle alongside the database snapshot so your family tree remains readable by any genealogy application.
backups.emptyDesc: Click "Download Full Archive (Database & Media)" above to generate your first complete snapshot.

upcoming.profileDesc: Personal display preferences, home person selection, and monthly digest settings.
upcoming.usersDesc: Family member invitations, role assignment, and one-time sign-in links.
upcoming.securityDesc: Passkey registration, emergency recovery codes, password management, and active session revocation.
upcoming.gedcomDesc: GEDCOM 5.5.1 / 7.0 import, GEDZIP export, and duplicate reconciliation are part of Phase 2.

profile.title: Personal Profile & Preferences
profile.subtitle: Update your display name, preferred archive language, and color theme.

security.recoverySubtitle: Single-use codes for signing in if you lose access to your passkey device.
security.passwordSubtitle: Set a password for signing in on local network devices where passkeys or email links are unavailable.
security.sessionsSubtitle: Devices currently signed in to your account.

users.title: Family Members & Access Roles
users.subtitle: Invite relatives to explore or contribute to the family archive.
users.inviteModalDesc: Generate a one-time invitation link to share with your relative.
users.inviteCreatedDesc: Send this link to your relative via email or messenger. It expires in 7 days.
users.signInLinkDesc: Share this temporary sign-in link directly with the family member:
users.userDeactivatedToast: Member account deactivated and sessions revoked

roleModal.title: Change Family Member Role
roleModal.subtitle: Assign access permissions for {name}.
roleModal.roleAdminDesc: Full archive governance, backups, GEDCOM import/export, quality & merges.
roleModal.roleEditorDesc: Can create and edit people, unions, events, places, and upload photos.
roleModal.roleViewerDesc: Read-only access to the full family tree, including living relatives.
roleModal.soleAdminWarningDesc: This account is the only active administrator. Promote another family member to Administrator before changing this role.

deactivateModal.deactivateDesc: Deactivating {name} immediately signs out all of their active devices and blocks sign-in until reactivated.
deactivateModal.reactivateDesc: Reactivating {name} restores their ability to sign in with their assigned role.
deactivateModal.soleAdminWarning: The sole active administrator cannot be deactivated.

rbac.accessDeniedDesc: This section is restricted to archive administrators. You can manage your own profile and passkeys or return to the family tree.
rbac.soleAdminError: Cannot demote or deactivate the sole remaining active administrator.

publicBanner.title: Living Family Members Are Protected
publicBanner.desc: You are browsing the public archive view. Names, birth dates, locations, and photographs of living relatives are masked as "Living". Sign in as a family member to view the complete tree.

privacyPreview.title: Family Tree & Living-Person Privacy
privacyPreview.subtitle: Server-enforced visibility based on your current access tier
